injection-override.description: Override an instruction injection: a config-relative path, none, or default. Convention: .agents/injections/…

setup.description: Env-bootstrap command run inside each new worktree after creation (path relative to this config's directory).

yolo.description: Skip Codex/Claude permission prompts. Closest scope wins; soul and launch overrides take precedence.

team.description: The deployment/team boundary. Closest scope declaring team: wins; used for identity, cross-repo agent discovery (oats status --team), and messaging providers.

launch-configs.description: Named ways to start a harness, independent of any soul. The closest scope declaring a name provides the whole entry (no merging between scopes). Selected by name at spawn or session start/restart; explicit flags override its fields.

runtime.description: The harness family this configuration starts; it decides the kernel's own baseline arguments (skills, instructions, task) and how model/yolo are expressed.

executable.description: The program to run instead of the runtime's default binary: a bare name is looked up on PATH on the execution host; a path containing a slash is resolved against the declaring scope's directory when relative. Checked to exist and be executable before any start; never executed just to probe it.

args.description: Extra arguments, each passed literally (no shell interpretation): native configuration files or profiles go here as ordinary arguments.

env.description: Environment for the harness. A string is a literal (non-secret by contract; still redacted in every answer). {fromEnv: NAME} is resolved from the execution host's environment at start time; the reference, never the value, is recorded. A missing reference refuses the start before anything stops.

model.description: Model for this configuration's runtime; overrides the soul default when this configuration is selected.

yolo.description: Permission bypass for this configuration; overrides scope and soul defaults when selected.

agent-types.description: Agent families declared by name; membership is `type: <name>` in each soul.yaml.

layers.description: The three exclusive fundamental slots: a capability entry or an explicit none.

templates.description: Named oats init templates: local config paths or git URLs whose main branch carries an oats-config.yaml.

agents-md-injection.description: Extra unconditional instruction blocks (adds content; does not override packaged defaults).
